newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain unemployment stable despite seasonal factors.
newsitem.headline: Spain unemployment stable despite seasonal factors.

text.p: Spain's Economy Ministry said on Friday unemployment was unchanged in October at 21.81 percent despite strong seasonal factors, and job creation remained high in the light of economic growth.

"The survey showed a decline in jobless of around 4,400 people versus the previous month, which is positive in a period of the year strongly influenced by seasonal factors" the ministry said in a statement.
Earlier on Friday the National Statistics Institute (INE) said unemployment was 21.81 percent of the workforce in October compared with 21.80 in September.
"The creation of jobs is intense in relation to economic growth," the ministry said.

The data are based on an INE survey of households (EPA) which is conducted on a three month rolling base, where September figures comprise August, September and October. The Economy Ministry added that permanent contracts rose 6.3 percent while temporary jobs rose a mere 1.4 pct.
